theme.zh: 存储供应商重塑AI基础设施

dek.en: Samsung's 3D-memory roadmap and a tightening DRAM market put bandwidth, storage density, and supplier leverage at the center of AI-infrastructure planning. Custom silicon and export controls widen the decisions operators must make around that constraint.
dek.zh: 三星的3D存储路线图与趋紧的DRAM市场，正将带宽、存储密度和供应商议价权推到AI基础设施规划的中心。定制芯片和出口管制也在扩大运营商必须围绕这一约束作出的决策。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Anthropic confirms work on a custom chip for Claude
title.zh: Anthropic确认正为Claude开发定制芯片

summary.en: Anthropic has confirmed that it is working on a dedicated ASIC for Claude, according to the report. A custom inference chip could improve its control over serving cost and capacity as model use grows. The report also says ByteDance has prohibited distillation of US models internally, tying model access more closely to hardware strategy.
summary.zh: 报道称，Anthropic已确认正在为Claude开发专用ASIC。随着模型使用量增长，定制推理芯片可能提升其对服务成本和算力容量的控制力。报道还称字节跳动在内部禁止蒸馏美国模型，使模型获取与硬件战略更加紧密相连。

title.en: Ayar Labs sees co-packaged optics scaling in 2028–29
title.zh: Ayar Labs预计共封装光学将在2028至2029年放量

summary.en: Ayar Labs' CEO said scale-up volumes for co-packaged optics could rise in 2028 and 2029. The timetable places optical I/O beyond the immediate accelerator cycle, but signals where electrical interconnect limits could become more binding. Packaging yield and system economics will determine whether that outlook converts into deployments.
summary.zh: Ayar Labs首席执行官表示，共封装光学的规模化出货量可能在2028年和2029年上升。这一时间表把光学I/O放在当前加速器周期之后，但显示电互连限制可能愈发突出。封装良率和系统经济性将决定这一预期能否转化为部署。

stories.source: GNews — Lightmatter / Ayar Labs / Celestial AI

title.en: Memory & Storage
title.zh: 存储与存储系统

title.en: Samsung lays out zHBM and 3D memory roadmap
title.zh: 三星公布zHBM与3D存储路线图

summary.en: Samsung presented zHBM and zNAND-O concepts for AI infrastructure alongside 3D stacking plans. EE Times reports Samsung is targeting up to eight times HBM5 performance for zHBM. The roadmap is forward-looking, but it shows memory suppliers moving the bandwidth bottleneck closer to the accelerator package.
summary.zh: 三星展示了面向AI基础设施的zHBM和zNAND-O概念，以及3D堆叠方案。EE Times报道称，三星为zHBM设定了最高达HBM5八倍性能的目标。这仍是面向未来的路线图，但显示存储供应商正试图把带宽瓶颈进一步移向加速器封装附近。

title.en: DRAM price rise shifts pressure among memory leaders
title.zh: DRAM涨价改变存储龙头的份额压力

summary.en: A DigiTimes report says the DRAM price surge is benefiting Samsung and Micron while SK hynix loses share. A broad DRAM up-cycle can change supplier leverage even as HBM remains the headline AI-memory constraint. The candidate report provides no shipment or pricing figures, so the scale of the shift remains to be confirmed.
summary.zh: DigiTimes报道称，DRAM价格飙升正在利好三星和美光，而SK海力士的份额有所流失。即使HBM仍是AI存储的核心约束，广泛的DRAM上行周期也可能改变供应商之间的相对议价能力。候选报道未给出出货或价格数据，因此这一变化的幅度仍有待确认。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Samsung and SK hynix reportedly weigh Chinese fab equipment
title.zh: 报道称三星与SK海力士正评估中国晶圆厂设备

summary.en: Samsung and SK hynix are reportedly considering more Chinese equipment for their China-based fabs as insulation against future US export controls. If pursued, the move would open a practical path for domestic Chinese tool vendors in mature production lines. The report describes testing and consideration, not confirmed procurement.
summary.zh: 报道称，三星和SK海力士正考虑在其中国晶圆厂更多采用中国设备，以降低未来美国出口管制的影响。若付诸实施，这将为中国本土设备厂商进入成熟制程产线带来实际窗口。该报道描述的是测试和评估，而非已确认采购。

title.en: US senators renew bid to extend chip manufacturing tax credit
title.zh: 美国参议员再度推动延长芯片制造税收抵免

summary.en: Senators Mike Crapo and Ron Wyden renewed a bipartisan push to extend the US semiconductor manufacturing tax credit. The effort keeps domestic fab and supply-chain investment costs on the policy agenda as projects advance into construction and operation. The candidate report does not state whether the measure has advanced through Congress.
summary.zh: 参议员Mike Crapo和Ron Wyden再度推动以跨党派方式延长美国半导体制造税收抵免。这一行动使本土晶圆厂和供应链投资的成本问题继续留在政策议程上，正值项目进入建设与运营阶段。候选报道未说明相关法案是否已在国会取得实质进展。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: TechInsights projects a 98.3% semiconductor-market increase
title.zh: TechInsights预计半导体市场增长98.3%

summary.en: TechInsights' June 2026 McClean Report update forecasts 98.3% global semiconductor-market growth, according to SemiWiki. The forecast attributes the expansion to AI infrastructure and severe constraints in advanced logic and memory. Such a high aggregate figure makes its supply, pricing, and AI-spending assumptions especially important to watch.
summary.zh: 据SemiWiki报道，TechInsights的2026年6月McClean Report更新预计全球半导体市场将增长98.3%。该预测将增长归因于AI基础设施需求，以及先进逻辑和存储的严重供给约束。如此高的整体预测使供给、定价和AI资本开支等假设尤其值得跟踪。

title.en: ASUS and Gigabyte reportedly raise China GPU prices
title.zh: 华硕与技嘉据报上调中国GPU价格

summary.en: ASUS and Gigabyte reportedly raised GPU prices in China by about 20%, with flagship models rising by as much as $666. The report says the increases affect both Nvidia RTX 50 and AMD Radeon RX 9000 cards. Board-partner pricing is an imperfect read-through to accelerator demand, but it signals component and channel pressure.
summary.zh: 据报道，华硕和技嘉已将中国市场GPU价格上调约20%，旗舰型号最高增加666美元。报道指涨价涉及Nvidia RTX 50和AMD Radeon RX 9000系列。板卡伙伴的定价并不能完全反映加速器需求，但可作为零部件与渠道压力的信号。

theme.zh: 数据搬运重塑加速器设计

dek.en: This week's papers treat memory bandwidth, KV-cache representation, and quantization as first-order architecture choices. They span PIM-GPU systems, dedicated inference datapaths, wafer processing, and power-aware EDA.
dek.zh: 本周论文将内存带宽、KV缓存表示和量化视为一阶架构选择。研究覆盖PIM-GPU系统、专用推理数据通路、晶圆加工以及面向功耗的EDA。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Deltoris: Bit-sparse speculative inference for real-time VLA models
title.zh: Deltoris：面向实时VLA模型的位级稀疏推测推理

papers.authors: Zheng Liu, Zeyu Guo, et al.

summary.en: Deltoris co-designs bit-level temporal sparsity and speculative inference for diffusion-based vision-language-action models. The authors report up to 34.2× speedup over mobile GPUs and 6.1× over a prior accelerator for 50–200 Hz control loops. These are proposed-accelerator evaluations, so hardware cost and model coverage remain open questions.
summary.zh: Deltoris针对基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作模型，将位级时间稀疏性与推测推理进行协同设计。作者报告称，面向50至200Hz控制循环时，其速度最高可达移动GPU的34.2倍、此前加速器的6.1倍。这些结果基于所提出的加速器评估，硬件成本和模型覆盖范围仍是未解问题。

title.en: Design principles for heterogeneous DRAM-PIM-GPU systems
title.zh: 异构DRAM-PIM-GPU系统的设计原则

papers.authors: Corey Lammie, Hadjer Benmeziane, et al.

summary.en: This study evaluates DRAM-PIM-GPU systems for decode-phase LLM inference across OPT and Mamba2 workloads. It finds static power can make dynamic-only models overstate tokens per watt by up to 3.85×, while channel count and hierarchy choices dominate outcomes. It is a design-space study rather than a new silicon implementation, but makes deployment assumptions explicit.
summary.zh: 该研究在OPT和Mamba2工作负载上评估了解码阶段LLM推理的DRAM-PIM-GPU系统。研究发现，静态功耗可使仅考虑动态功耗的模型将每瓦token数高估最多3.85倍，而通道数和层级配置主导结果。这是一项设计空间研究而非新的芯片实现，但明确了部署假设的重要性。

title.en: AI Systems & Inference
title.zh: AI系统与推理

title.en: KV-cache vector quantization that preserves attention
title.zh: 保持注意力特性的KV缓存向量量化

papers.authors: Samuel Fernández-Menduiña, Amir Ziashahabi, et al.

summary.en: This paper frames KV-cache quantization as transform coding whose distortion is attention-product error, not generic reconstruction error. It derives calibration-based transforms for keys and values to make two-bit-per-element compression more attention-aware. The serving benefit will depend on transform overhead and workload stability.
summary.zh: 该论文将KV缓存量化表述为变换编码问题，其失真度量是注意力乘积误差，而非通用重构误差。它为键和值推导基于校准数据的变换，使每元素两比特的压缩更能保持注意力特性。实际服务收益将取决于变换开销和工作负载稳定性。

title.en: Signed-digit KV caches for ternary LLM inference
title.zh: 面向三值LLM推理的有符号数字KV缓存

papers.authors: Ziang Duan, Jiajun Wu, et al.

summary.en: The authors store online K/V states as scaled multi-plane signed digits so attention can use the lookup-table machinery of ternary projections. The design avoids dense K/V materialization and handles incomplete cache blocks during causal decoding. The abstract does not establish end-to-end model quality or silicon efficiency.
summary.zh: 作者提出将在线生成的K/V状态存为缩放的多平面有符号数字，使注意力计算能够复用三值投影的查找表机制。该设计避免K/V的稠密实体化，并处理自回归解码中未完成的缓存块。摘要未证明端到端模型质量或芯片效率。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Self-focusing control for precise 4H-SiC wafer slicing
title.zh: 用于精确4H-SiC晶圆切片的自聚焦控制

papers.authors: Dong Hee Kang, Jaeseung Lim, et al.

summary.en: The work links femtosecond-laser pulse energy and processing depth to Kerr self-focusing during 4H-SiC wafer slicing. Experiments, modelling, and ray-optics simulations connect the effect to surface texture and separation stress. Better control could support thin SiC layers, although production yield is not yet demonstrated.
summary.zh: 该工作将飞秒激光脉冲能量和加工深度与4H-SiC晶圆切片过程中的Kerr自聚焦联系起来。实验、建模和光线光学仿真将其与表面纹理及分离应力相关联。更好的工艺控制有望支持薄SiC层，但尚未证明量产良率。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: DiffPower: Differentiable GPU switching-power analysis
title.zh: DiffPower：可微分GPU开关功耗分析

papers.authors: Isaac Jacobson, Zheng Zhao, et al.

summary.en: DiffPower converts netlists into PDK-agnostic bytecode and uses reverse-mode automatic differentiation for GPU-accelerated switching-power analysis. It reports up to 1,002× speedup over single-threaded CPU propagation and a median toggle-rate correlation of 0.96 across ten designs. Signoff accuracy will require validation against production flows.
summary.zh: DiffPower将网表转换为与PDK无关的字节码，并使用反向模式自动微分实现GPU加速的开关功耗分析。它报告相对单线程CPU传播最高1002倍加速，并在十个设计上取得0.96的开关率相关系数中位数。签核精度仍需相对量产流程验证。
